headline: Binance Halts Transfers After Security Incident Threatens $6.3B in Losses
summary: Binance suspended deposits and withdrawals after an apparent hack. The world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange is assessing a security incident that may cause $6.3 billion in losses.
why: Binance accounts for a dominant share of global cryptocurrency trading volume. Major operational or security failures at the exchange pose systemic liquidity and counterparty risks across digital asset markets.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: A potential multi-billion-dollar breach and transaction halts at the largest exchange trigger broad selling pressure.
